title: Designing Algorithmic Recommendations to Achieve Human-AI Complementarity
abstract: arXiv:2405.01484v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Algorithms frequently assist, rather than replace, human decision-makers. However, the design and analysis of algorithms often focus on predicting outcomes and do not explicitly model their effect on human decisions. This discrepancy between the design and role of algorithmic assistants becomes particularly concerning in light of empirical evidence that suggests that algorithmic assistants again and again fail to improve human decisions. translated_title: 设计算法推荐以实现人机互补
translated_abstract: arXiv:2405.01484v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：算法经常是辅助而非取代人类决策者。然而，算法的设计与分析通常聚焦于预测结果，并未明确建模其对人类决策的影响。鉴于实证证据一再表明算法辅助工具无法改善人类决策，算法助手的设计与其角色之间的这种差异尤其令人担忧。在本文中，我们对推荐算法的设计进行了形式化，使其能够辅助人类决策者，而无需对推荐如何影响决策做出限制性的先验假设。我们构建了一个算法设计问题，利用因果推断中的潜在结果框架来建模推荐对人类决策者二元处理选择的影响。在此模型中，我们建立了算法推荐与工具变量之间的联系。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果推断潜在结果框架的算法设计方法，将算法推荐与工具变量相联系，无需对推荐效果做先验假设即可设计出实现人机互补的推荐算法。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the design of recommendation algorithms for human-AI complementarity by leveraging the potential-outcomes framework from causal inference and connecting algorithmic recommendations to instrumental variables, without requiring restrictive ex-ante assumptions about how recommendations affect human decisions.
